architectures.abstraction: 1D continuous preloaded bar with a local axial force surrogate
architectures.notes: Static 1D axial equilibrium redistributes force globally and does not create localized relief.

architectures.abstraction: uniform preload plus local negative eigenstrain over the optical trough
architectures.notes: Ideal reduced-order eigenstrain directly matches the optical trough shape.

architectures.abstraction: symmetric counter-strain pair represented as a high-transfer local eigenstrain
architectures.notes: Symmetry reduces net translation in this reduced-order abstraction but still needs high strain transfer.

architectures.abstraction: local actuator free strain transferred through an exponential shear-lag length
architectures.notes: Requires transfer length substantially below the optical transition scale to preserve localization.

architectures.abstraction: constant-force bar with locally increased EA
architectures.notes: A 10x local stiffness ratio gives only partial relief; exact zero strain would require an unbounded ratio under constant force.

architectures.abstraction: local optical region coupled through compliant effective interfaces
architectures.notes: Isolation improves localization in 1D but introduces fabrication and optical-continuity risks.

architectures.abstraction: four mechanically coupled zones with nearest-neighbor leakage
architectures.notes: Array cross-coupling reduces trough depth before any detailed optimization.
